\section*{Conformance rule}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Conformance rule}

An implementation or product is conforming only for the requirements whose
complete dependencies are available and whose exact identities and states are
recorded. Typed unavailability is conforming when a dependency is absent and
the contract requires fail-closed behavior. Fabricating a default, zero,
alias, route substitution, association, covariance, response, bias, or use
decision is nonconforming.

The shared common core is the normative scientific source. The rationale
explains that source. This ECS supplies prospective engineering evidence
procedure and authors no independent science. A change to any common-core byte
requires a new binding and document generation.

\section{Engineering record contracts}\label{sec:engineering-records}

The representation syntax is implementation-defined, but the following
logical records and fields shall be lossless, queryable, and immutable for a
published result. Co-location in one table or file does not merge identities.

\subsection{Stage-specific record separation}\label{sec:fit-request-record}

\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.27\linewidth}p{0.65\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Record & Required logical fields \\
\midrule
\endhead
A. Request and parent & Immutable request; observation/array; requested parent, method, and uses; exact parent identity/science; source reference; \path{known}, \path{isolated}, \path{bright}, and \path{approximately_centered} facts; requested search/fit domains, initialization, fallback, constraints, support/weights, and unresolved sentinels. No selected seed, fit value, association outcome, realized constraint/residual, or applied/realized outcome. \\
B. Effective configuration & Every sentinel and requested option resolved to one explicit effective value or typed unavailable state. \\
C. Resolved method/plan & One frozen compatible method, route, support, objective, weighting, constraints, fallback, comparison, termination, and failure plan. \\
D. Application attempt & Applied plan, invocation/attempt identity, branch/restart/retry identity, execution state, cause, and provenance. \\
E. Realized fit/components & Selected seed; numerical values; component states; association outcome; realized constraints; residual; diagnostics; response, bias, and uncertainty states; causes and provenance. \\
F. Publication candidate & Every required POINT value-or-status role, identity, cause, provenance, and structural-completeness state; POINT publication state; and linked requested decision identities/statuses where required, without requiring every downstream use to succeed. \\
G. Publication decision & POINT fit-completeness profile and source bindings; decision, reasons, identity, lifecycle, and provenance. \\
H. Published product & Accepted immutable candidate; exact role, version, generation, inherited parent observation/exposure lineage or typed \path{not_applicable}, lifecycle, and provenance. POINT creates no exposure identity. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Realized fit and component record}\label{sec:fit-result-record}

When a numerical fit is authorized, record E shall carry branch and selected
seed or peak identity; association method, domain, state, and cause; admitted support and row
count; exact objective and fit-weight identity; parameter values with units
and conventions; per-component identifiability; active constraints; rank;
termination, convergence, and retry; fitted model or reconstructibility;
residual and diagnostics; parent additive-reference and null state; fixed,
POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed, and whole-chain full-procedure response
identities/states; observational bias and accuracy state; formal-error and covariance identities
and states; and every typed cause of unavailability or failure. Its numerical
$A$ role is
\begin{center}
\path{POINT-FIT-AMPLITUDE-COMPONENT}.
\end{center}
Only established association may create the separately typed
source-associated amplitude role:
\begin{center}
\path{POINT-SOURCE-ASSOCIATED-}\\[-0.25em]
\path{AMPLITUDE-DIAGNOSTIC}.
\end{center}

The source association record shall cover every central, global-fallback,
restart, retry, or other branch. It is a separate product role and cannot be
derived from fit quality.

\subsection{Displacement record}\label{sec:displacement-record}

A displacement record shall contain the associated fit identity; expected
source-position identity; fitted centroid; exact ordered basis vectors;
handedness and positive directions; arcsecond unit; coordinate state/time;
parent-to-tangent transform and Jacobian where relevant; source and coordinate
uncertainty states; Equation~\ref{eq:displacement} sign declaration; support,
validity, lifecycle, and provenance. It shall contain no implied correction
sign or applied-correction claim.

\subsection{Named-use evaluation record}\label{sec:named-use-record}

For each named use, record profile identity/version/digest, policy owner,
immutable fit reference, source bindings, request, applicability, eligibility,
realization, reason,
prescribed consumer action, evaluation identity, lifecycle, and provenance.
The four axes shall be the exact independent SCI-VAL enumerations:
request is \path{requested} or \path{not_requested}; applicability is
\path{applicable}, \path{inapplicable}, or
\path{applicability_unknown}; eligibility is \path{eligible},
\path{ineligible}, or \path{decision_unavailable}; realization is
\path{realized}, \path{incomplete}, \path{failed}, or
\path{not_produced}. Where the owner-bound crosswalk specifies no
applicability or eligibility proposition, the record shall preserve genuine
absence rather than invent an enumeration value. The evaluator shall apply
Section~\ref{sec:val-function}. The action field may contain
\texttt{diagnostic\_display\_only}; that token is no axis or producer state.
No result from one named use may modify another or the fit, create a new fit
generation, rescue another use, or block base completion merely because the
downstream artifact is unrequested, unavailable, incomplete, failed, or absent.

\subsection{Availability precedence}\label{sec:availability-precedence}

For each product request, evaluate in order: exact parent and route boundary;
method authority; coordinate/source boundary; applicability facts; attempted
producer application and realization; component identifiability; source association; the
product row in Section~\ref{sec:dependencies}; then each requested named-use
profile. Stop only the dependent product or claim. Preserve independent
siblings and record the exact blocking state. An early stop preserves only
the lifecycle stages reached and records exact terminal \path{unavailable},
\path{failed}, or \path{not_produced} state with cause; it never fabricates
\path{applied} or \path{fit_realized} and never silently drops a requested row.

\subsection{Response and covariance records}\label{sec:response-records}

A response record shall bind comparable numerical baseline and perturbed
products/states; intended source and association; parameter roles; gauge and
canonical ordering; units and basis; target-component availability;
perturbation source, domain, direction, unit, and $\epsilon$; perturbation-domain
relation; branch changes; method; finite versus analytic convention; state,
cause, and provenance. It shall identify exactly one of fixed POINT response,
fixed parent response, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed response, whole-chain
full-procedure response, or empirical bias/accuracy. Incomparable outputs are
unavailable or a typed discontinuity/state transition, never a subtraction of
lifecycle objects. A whole-chain record requires exact upstream rerun authority;
no finite-difference record is composed as a Jacobian without an exact theorem. A
conditional displacement-covariance record shall bind every term of
Equation~\ref{eq:displacement-covariance}, the common basis, transformations
and Jacobians, independence authority where any cross term is zero, validity,
state, cause, and provenance.

\section{Method-record acceptance criteria}\label{sec:method-record-criteria}

\CompatMethod{} shall not become available unless one immutable,
content-bound, owner-approved record specifies the exact source equation and
parameter ordering; width and angle conventions; domains and constraints;
rows and residual; objective/likelihood; exact consumed $W_{\mathrm{fit}}$ and
every approved uniform/reliability/covariance/inverse-covariance/other source
mapping identity, units, normalization, support, lifecycle state, claim
ceiling, and provenance; expected-position/search-center distinction; central and
global search; score, candidate, interpolation, tie, initialization, fallback,
association, retry, and sentinel rules; solver-independent solution
comparison; convergence, rank, identifiability, failure, and compatibility
status; and numerical tests for each applicability class or typed
unavailability.

\FormalMethod{} shall separately specify the fitted parameterization,
stochastic model, weight relation, exact covariance/error construction,
observed/expected curvature, residual scaling, degrees of freedom, rank and
positive-definiteness rules, transformations, marginal extraction, active
bounds, circularity/axis degeneracy, weak identification, consistency checks,
units, scope, omitted uncertainty, and unavailable/failed states.

\RMSMethod{} shall separately specify the exact signal parent and generation,
full-map population, about-zero RMS versus centered deviation, center/mean,
weighting, source-region treatment, support/edge/validity, non-finite and
zero-denominator behavior, units, lifecycle/provenance, and identity relation
to the amplitude parent.

The method records shall also state whether and how \texttt{sig2noise} or
\texttt{fit\_sig2noise} is mathematically identical to the corresponding signed
canonical quantity before approving it as a legacy alias. No alias is admitted merely
by this contract text, and \texttt{peak\_over\_full\_map\_rms} requires a
separate compatibility-method finding. The absolute-magnitude standardization
identity is likewise unadmitted without separate request and authority.

\section{Owner-decision parity and remaining approvals}\label{sec:owner-parity}

The engineering contract has one-to-one coverage of ODQ-001 through ODQ-009,
including ODQ-003A/003B, and preserves the three distinct method dispositions.
The generic conditional science contains no unresolved ODQ. Remaining owner
actions are: content-bound approval of the three method records; approval of
exact numerical route instances; final review and registration of the four
draft profile identities/mechanics; and separate authorization of fixed,
POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed, whole-chain full-procedure, or observational
bias/accuracy authorities if those claims are sought.

The r0.3 owner/view parity report records gap-free REQ-001--REQ-038 and
PRED-001--PRED-032, exact common-core imports in both views, canonical token
checks, and distinct release conditions for fixed, POINT-full-procedure with a
fixed parent, whole-chain full-procedure, and observational bias/accuracy. The complete
delivery packet contains the exact Stage A archive and sidecars, common core,
exact owner directive, both document sources, boundary/profile/method templates, traceability,
manifests, build recipe, and QA records.

\section{Nonclaims}\label{sec:engineering-nonclaims}

This specification records no implementation inspection and claims no
implementation conformity, numerical production, representation fidelity,
response/covariance fidelity, uncertainty coverage, observational validation,
pointing accuracy, performance, readiness, production suitability, production
authorization, or Unity activity.
